typescript_sql_authorities.description: Production TypeScript modules that still know about the synchronous SQLite service. This allowlist may shrink, never grow.

typescript_sql_drivers.description: Production TypeScript modules importing node:sqlite or better-sqlite3. RFC 010 leaves these as a transitional boundary only.

typescript_query_projection_mutators.description: Query modules that still invoke projection ensure/rebuild work. RFC 011 moves this work to the writer.

source_specific_runtime_services.description: Legacy source-local lifecycle, live, watcher, and checkpoint services. New adapters must use the common Rust engine runtime.

rust_common_source_dispatch.description: Source-id branching outside adapter modules. Existing branches are migration debt; new common-engine branches are forbidden.

rust_source_boundary_violations.description: The common Rust source layer cannot depend on vendor adapters, the Spaghetti engine/store, N-API, or JSON decoders.

rust_adapter_storage_boundary_violations.description: Rust adapter contracts and vendor adapters cannot depend on Spaghetti storage, writer/event internals, orchestration, or N-API.
